CoffeeCalc.metadataTitle: Coffee Cost Calculator — How Many Cups of Coffee?
CoffeeCalc.metadataDescription: Free online coffee calculator: convert any price into cups (espresso, latte, cappuccino & more). 14 currencies. Budget and compare spending—no signup.
CoffeeCalc.title: How Many <accent>Coffees</accent> Is That?
CoffeeCalc.subtitle: Convert any price into cups of coffee. Because everything makes more sense measured in caffeine.
funFacts: Finland consumes the most coffee per capita — about 12 kg per person per year!
Coffee is the second most traded commodity on Earth, right after crude oil.
The average American spends about $1,100 per year on coffee.
A Starbucks Grande Latte in Zurich costs around $7.50 — one of the priciest in the world.
Brazil produces about a third of the world's coffee supply.
CoffeeCalc.seoText: We spend on coffee every day, making it the perfect unit to understand the real cost of things. Whether you're budgeting, comparing prices, or just curious — CoffeeCalc helps you see any price through the lens of your favorite drink. Multi-currency support lets you compare coffee costs worldwide.
CoffeeCalc.faq1Q: How does CoffeeCalc turn a price into cups of coffee?
CoffeeCalc.faq1A: We use approximate average prices for each drink type, convert your amount with exchange rates, then estimate how many cups that money represents. Real café prices vary, so treat results as a quick benchmark—not a quote.
CoffeeCalc.faq2Q: Which drinks and currencies can I use?
CoffeeCalc.faq2A: Six drink types (espresso, cappuccino, latte, americano, mocha, cold brew) and 14 major currencies for fast comparisons at home or abroad.
CoffeeCalc.faq3Q: Is it free? Do I need an account?
CoffeeCalc.faq3A: Yes—CoffeeCalc is free in your browser and you don't need to sign up.
CoffeeCalc.faq4Q: Why compare costs in coffee cups?
CoffeeCalc.faq4A: Coffee is an everyday purchase for many people, so “how many lattes is this?” makes amounts easier to reason about when budgeting or weighing a splurge.
CoffeeCalc.schemaFeature1: Six drink types you can compare side by side
CoffeeCalc.schemaFeature3: Runs in the browser with no account required
CoffeeCalc.disclaimer: Prices are approximate averages. Actual coffee prices vary by location.
